title: Shielded pool balances
description: ZEC held in each shielded pool, per day.

title: Issued supply
description: Issued ZEC, split into shielded and transparent.

title: Shielded share of supply
description: Share of issued ZEC held in shielded pools.

title: After deshielding
description: ZEC by the day it left a shielded pool, grouped by where it went next.

title: Leading mining pool share
description: Share of each day’s blocks mined by the largest pool.

title: Search interest in “zcash”
description: Worldwide Google Trends interest in “zcash”, scaled 0–100 within the export window.

title: Daily transaction activity
description: Shielded and transparent transactions per day, excluding coinbase.

title: Shielded transaction share
description: Share of each day’s transactions that are shielded, excluding coinbase.

title: Privacy Score history
description: ZecBlock’s Privacy Score out of 100. Steps can come from formula changes.

title: Public shielding flows
description: Public ZEC entering and leaving shielded pools each day.

title: Net public shielding
description: Shielding minus deshielding each day.

title: Flows above an amount
description: Shielding and deshielding flows at or above each amount.

title: Flows by amount range
description: Shielding and deshielding flows by amount range.

title: Estimated network hashrate
description: Daily network hashrate, estimated from difficulty and block times.

title: Blocks by mining pool
description: Blocks mined by each pool.

title: Coinbase reward spending
description: Mining rewards earned each day, and how much has since moved or is still held.

title: Recent block intervals
description: Seconds between consecutive recent blocks.

title: Mining difficulty
description: Mining difficulty, averaged over 100 blocks.

title: Fees per block
description: Average fees per block each day, excluding the block reward. Blocks became three times as frequent at NU7 on November 6, 2026.

title: Transactions per block
description: Average transactions per block each day. Blocks became three times as frequent at NU7 on November 6, 2026.

title: Observed transaction fees
description: Daily median transaction fee, with the 10th–90th percentile range.

title: Explorer node storage
description: Disk space used by ZecBlock’s own node.

title: Shielded note commitments
description: Running total of shielded outputs by pool. Includes padding, so it is not a count of users.

title: Shielded nullifiers
description: Shielded spends by pool. Includes dummy spends, so it is not a count of transfers.

title: Price and modeled realized price
description: Daily ZEC price next to its modeled realized price (average cost basis).

title: MVRV
description: Market cap divided by modeled realized cap.

title: Modeled unrealized profit / loss
description: Modeled unrealized profit or loss as a share of market cap. Same model as MVRV.

title: SOPR · transparent spends
description: Value of spent transparent outputs relative to their value when created.

title: Market and modeled realized cap
description: Market cap next to the modeled realized cap.

title: Age of spent ZEC
description: Average age of transparent ZEC spent each day.

title: Coin-days destroyed
description: Transparent ZEC moved each day, weighted by how long it sat unspent.

title: Unspent ZEC by output age
description: Transparent ZEC grouped by how long it has sat unspent.

title: Cross-chain swap volume
description: USD value of swaps into and out of ZEC through tracked cross-chain providers.

title: Cross-chain swap activity
description: Swaps into and out of ZEC through tracked cross-chain providers.
